evidence.pali: ‘‘Ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? Atthi, bhikkhave, pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. Tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro – ayamāhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 诸比丘，何为令未生之喜觉支生起，已生之喜觉支修习圆满之食？诸比丘，有喜觉支所缘法(pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā)。于此，多作如理作意——此为令未生之喜觉支生起，已生之喜觉支修习圆满之食。
evidence.english: And what, monks, is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of rapture, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of rapture? There are, monks, things that are a basis for the enlightenment factor of rapture. Therein, frequent wise attention—this is the nutriment for the arising of the unarisen enlightenment factor of rapture, or for the fulfillment through development of the arisen enlightenment factor of rapture.

entries.pali: Ārammaṇavasena panettha somanassasahagatabhāvo veditabbo. Iṭṭhārammaṇasmiñhi uppannattā etaṃ somanassasahagataṃ jātaṃ. Saddhābahulatādīnipettha kāraṇāniyeva. Assaddhānañhi micchādiṭṭhīnañca ekantaiṭṭhārammaṇabhūtaṃ tathāgatarūpampi disvā somanassaṃ nuppajjati. Ye ca kusalappavattiyaṃ ānisaṃsaṃ na passanti tesaṃ parehi ussāhitānaṃ kusalaṃ karontānampi somanassaṃ nuppajjati. Tasmā saddhābahulatā visuddhadiṭṭhitā ānisaṃsadassāvitāti. Evampettha somanassasahagatabhāvo veditabbo. Apica ekādasadhammā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti – buddhānussati dhammānussati saṅghānussati sīlānussati cāgānussati devatānussati upasamānussati lūkhapuggalaparivajjanatā siniddhapuggalasevanatā pasādanīyasuttantapaccavekkhaṇatā tadadhimuttatāti . Imehipi kāraṇehettha somanassasahagatabhāvo veditabbo. Imesaṃ pana vitthāro bojjhaṅgavibhaṅge (vibha. aṭṭha. 367 bojjhaṅgapabbavaṇṇanā, 468-469) āvi bhavissati.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于此，当依所缘了知喜俱行(somanassasahagata)。诚然，因其于可意所缘中生起，此心即成为喜俱行。于此，多信等亦实为原因。诚然，无信者及邪见者，即使见到已成极可意所缘的如来色身，亦不生喜。又，于善法生起时不见其利益者，即使被他人鼓励而行善，亦不生喜。是故，多信、见清净、能见利益，亦是原因。如是，于此亦当了知喜俱行。再者，有十一法能导向喜觉支(pītisambojjhaṅga)的生起：佛随念、法随念、僧随念、戒随念、舍随念、天随念、寂静随念、远离粗恶之人、亲近柔和之人、省思能引生净信之经、于彼有胜解。依此等因缘，亦当了知此处的喜俱行。又，此等之广说，将于《觉支分别》(Bojjhaṅgavibhaṅga)中阐明。
entries.english: Herein, the state of being accompanied by joy should be understood by the power of the object. Because it has arisen in relation to a desirable object, it has become accompanied by joy. Abundance of faith and so on are also causes here. For the faithless and for those of wrong view, joy does not arise even after seeing the form of the Tathāgata, which is an exclusively desirable object. And for those who do not see the benefit in the occurrence of the wholesome, joy does not arise even while performing a wholesome deed when urged by others. Therefore, it is due to abundance of faith, purity of view, and seeing the benefits. Thus, the state of being accompanied by joy should be understood herein. Moreover, eleven factors conduce to the arising of the joy enlightenment-factor: recollection of the Buddha, recollection of the Dhamma, recollection of the Saṅgha, recollection of virtue, recollection of generosity, recollection of deities, recollection of peace, avoidance of coarse individuals, association with gentle individuals, reflection upon inspiring suttas, and being resolved on that. By these causes also, the state of being accompanied by joy should be understood herein. The detailed explanation of these, however, will become clear in the Bojjhaṅgavibhaṅga.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: ‘Antogadhānaṃ pabhedā’ ti dukkhasaccasmiñhi, ṭhapetvā taṇhañceva anāsavadhamme ca, sesā sabbadhammā antogadhā; samudayasacce chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni; nirodhasaccaṃ asammissaṃ; maggasacce sammādiṭṭhimukhena vīmaṃsiddhipādapaññindriyapaññābaladhammavicayasambojjhaṅgāni. Sammāsaṅkappāpadesena tayo nekkhammavitakkādayo, sammāvācāpadesena cattāri vacīsucaritāni, sammākammantāpadesena tīṇi kāyasucaritāni, sammāājīvamukhena appicchatā santuṭṭhitā ca, sabbesaṃyeva vā etesaṃ sammāvācākammantājīvānaṃ ariyakantasīlattā sīlassa ca saddhāhatthena paṭiggahetabbattā tesaṃ atthitāya ca atthibhāvato saddhindriyasaddhābalachandiddhipādā, sammāvāyāmāpadesena catubbidhasammappadhānavīriyindriyavīriyabalavīriyasambojjhaṅgāni, sammāsatiapadesena catubbidhasatipaṭṭhānasatindriyasatibalasatisambojjhaṅgāni, sammāsamādhiapadesena savitakkasavicārādayo tayo tayo samādhī, cittasamādhisamādhindriyasamādhibalapītipassaddhisamādhiupekkhāsambojjhaṅgāni antogadhānīti. Evamettha ‘antogadhānaṃ pabhedā’pi vinicchayo veditabbo.
entries.chinese_simplified: “‘内摄之分别’：于苦谛中，除渴爱与无漏法外，其余诸法皆为内摄；于集谛中，有三十六种渴爱行相；灭谛不与他法混杂；于道谛中，以正见为首，内摄观神足、慧根、慧力、择法觉支；以正思惟为代表，内摄出离思惟等三者；以正语为代表，内摄四种语妙行；以正业为代表，内摄三种身妙行；以正命为首，内摄少欲、知足；或因正语、正业、正命皆为圣者所爱之戒，戒又当以信之手接受，且因其存在与现起，故内摄信根、信力、欲神足；以正精进为代表，内摄四正勤、精进根、精进力、精进觉支；以正念为代表，内摄四念处、念根、念力、念觉支；以正定为代表，内摄有寻有伺等三种三摩地，以及心神足、定根、定力、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。如是，于此亦应知‘内摄之分别’的抉择。
entries.english: 'The classifications of what is included' – In the truth of suffering, except for craving and the taint-free states, all other states are included. In the truth of origin, the thirty-six modes of craving are included. The truth of cessation is unmixed. In the truth of the path, by way of right view, the basis of psychic power of investigation, the faculty of wisdom, the power of wisdom, and the enlightenment factor of investigation of states are included. By way of right intention, the three thoughts of renunciation and so on are included. By way of right speech, the four kinds of good verbal conduct are included. By way of right action, the three kinds of good bodily conduct are included. By way of right livelihood, having few wishes and contentment are included. Alternatively, since all these—right speech, right action, and right livelihood—are virtue dear to the noble ones, and since virtue is to be received with the hand of faith, their existence establishes the faculty of faith, the power of faith, and the basis of psychic power of aspiration. By way of right effort, the fourfold right exertions, the faculty of energy, the power of energy, and the enlightenment factor of energy are included. By way of right mindfulness, the four foundations of mindfulness, the faculty of mindfulness, the power of mindfulness, and the enlightenment factor of mindfulness are included. By way of right concentration, the three kinds of concentration—with applied and sustained thought, and so on—are included, along with concentration of mind, the faculty of concentration, the power of concentration, and the enlightenment factors of joy, tranquility, concentration, and equanimity. Thus, the analysis of 'the classifications of what is included' should also be understood in this way.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.english: For the enlightenment factor of rapture—

entries.pali: Caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhahantassa uppannavīriyaṃ vipassanāsahagatanti veditabbaṃ. Ettakenā ti ‘‘lokiyalokuttaramissakā kathitā’’ti ettāvatā. Lokiyanti vadanto na kilamatī ti kāyaviññattisamuṭṭhāpakassa lokiyattā acodanīyoti attho. Alabbha…pe… paṭikkhittā ti rūpāvacare alabbhamānakaṃ pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ upādāya labbhamānāpi avitakkaavicārā pīti paṭikkhittā, ‘‘pītisambojjhaṅgo’’ti na vuttoti attho. Kāmāvacare vā alabbhamānakaṃ avitakkaavicāraṃ pītiṃ upādāya labbhamānakāva pītibojjhaṅgabhūtā paṭikkhittā, avitakkaavicāro pītisambojjhaṅgo na vuttoti attho.
entries.chinese_simplified: 应知，经行者在经行时生起的精进是与观(vipassanā)相应的。所谓‘仅此’，是指‘世间与出世间混合而说’到此为止。说‘世间’时不会疲倦，其义是：由于生起身表的（心）属于世间，故不应受责难。所谓‘不可得……（乃至）……被拒绝’，是指在色界，就那不可得的喜觉支而言，即使是可得的无寻无伺之喜也被排除，其义是：未被称为‘喜觉支’。或者，在欲界，就那不可得的无寻无伺之喜而言，即使是可得的、已成为喜觉支的喜也被排除，其义是：无寻无伺的喜觉支未被提及。
entries.english: For one who undertakes walking meditation, the energy that has arisen should be understood as accompanied by insight. By this much: this means, “The mundane and supramundane have been discussed as mixed.” Regarding the phrase, “When speaking of the mundane, one does not become fatigued,” the meaning is that one is not to be blamed, because the originator of bodily intimation is mundane. “Unobtainable… rejected”: with reference to the joy-enlightenment factor being unobtainable in the form realm, even the joy that is obtainable without initial and sustained application is rejected, meaning it is not called the “joy-enlightenment factor.” Or, with reference to joy without initial and sustained application being unobtainable in the sensual realm, even the obtainable joys that constitute the joy-enlightenment factor are rejected, meaning joy without initial and sustained application is not called the “joy-enlightenment factor.”

entries.pali: 522 . Lokiyāyapi…pe… āhā ti idaṃ vipassanābhāvanāya satipaṭṭhānādayo ekasmiṃ ārammaṇe saha nappavattanti, pavattamānānipi indriyabalāni bojjhaṅgesveva antogadhāni honti. Pītisambojjhaṅgaggahaṇena hi tadupanissayabhūtaṃ saddhindriyaṃ saddhābalañca gahitameva hoti ‘‘saddhūpanisaṃ pāmojja’’nti (saṃ. ni. 2.23) vuttattā. Maggaṅgāni pañceva vipassanākkhaṇe pavattantīti imamatthaṃ sandhāya vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 522. 世间的……乃至……说，此谓在观（vipassanā）修习中，念处等法不会在一个所缘上同时生起，即使生起，诸根与诸力亦皆包含在觉支之中。因把握喜觉支，即等于把握以其为所依的信根与信力，正如‘信为喜悦之近因’（《相应部》2.23）所说。当知，此处是指只有五种道支在观的刹那生起，此乃所要表达之要点。
entries.english: 522. He says, 'Even in the mundane...'—here, the foundations of mindfulness and so on, in insight meditation, do not arise simultaneously on a single object; and even when they arise, the faculties and powers are included within the enlightenment factors. For by the inclusion of the enlightenment factor of joy, the faculty of faith and the power of faith, which are its supporting conditions, are already included, as it is said: 'Joy has faith as its decisive support' (Saṃyutta Nikāya 2.23). It should be understood that this statement—that only five path factors arise in the moment of insight—is made with this meaning in mind.

entries.pali: Rūpāvacare pītisambojjhaṅgoti na vuccatīti āha ‘‘rūpāvacare…pe… paṭikkhittā’’ ti. Yathā vipassanāsahagatā pīti pariyāyena ‘‘pītisambojjhaṅgo’’ti vuccati, evaṃ rūpāvacare pīti nibbedhabhāgiyā vattabbā siyā. Evaṃ labbhamānāpi alabbhamānaṃ upādāya na vuttā. ‘‘Avitakkaavicārā’’ ti visesanaṃ santapaṇītāya pītiyā dassanatthaṃ. Bojjhaṅgabhūtā ti pariyāyabojjhaṅgabhūtā. Avitakkaavicāro pīti…pe… na vutto savitakkasavicārattā tassa. Na hi kāmāvacarā avitakkaavicārā pīti atthi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 色界不说喜觉支，所以说‘色界……被拒绝’。正如与观(vipassanā)相应的喜，可以方便说为‘喜觉支’，同样，色界之喜若是属于通达分，亦可如是说。即使可以如此获得，但因涉及不可得者，故未如是说。‘无寻无伺’此一限定，是为了显示寂静、殊胜之喜。‘为觉支’是指方便说为觉支。无寻无伺之喜……未被称为（觉支），因为彼（觉支）是有寻有伺的。欲界确实没有无寻无伺的喜。
entries.english: He says that in the form sphere it is not called the 'enlightenment factor of rapture,' with the words: 'In the form sphere… it is rejected.' Just as rapture accompanied by insight is figuratively called the 'enlightenment factor of rapture,' so too, rapture in the form sphere, being a factor leading to penetration, might be spoken of. Even though it is obtainable in this way, it is not mentioned with reference to what is unobtainable. The qualification 'without thought and examination' is for the purpose of showing that the rapture is tranquil and sublime. 'Being an enlightenment factor' means being an enlightenment factor figuratively. Rapture without thought and examination… is not mentioned because that involves thought and examination. For in the sensual sphere there is no rapture without thought and examination.

entries.pali: 35 . Satta bojjhaṅgā – satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 35. 七觉支(bojjhaṅgā)：念觉支、择法觉支、精进觉支、喜觉支、轻安觉支、定觉支、舍觉支。
entries.english: 35. Seven enlightenment factors: the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, the enlightenment factor of investigation of dhammas, the enlightenment factor of energy, the enlightenment factor of rapture, the enlightenment factor of tranquility, the enlightenment factor of concentration, and the enlightenment factor of equanimity.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门古复注 Abhidhammāvatāra-Purāṇaṭīkā
entries.pali: Apica ye te ekādasa dhammā pītisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti. Seyyathidaṃ – buddhānussati dhammānussati saṃghānussati sīlānussati cāgānussati devatānussati upasamānussati lūkhapuggalaparivajjanaṃ siniddhapuggalasevanā pasādanīyasuttantapaccavekkhaṇā tadadhimuttatāti imehipi kāraṇehi cittassa somanassasahagatabhāvo veditabbo. Buddhādiguṇe anussarantassa hi yāva upacāruppādā sakalasarīraṃ pharamānā pīti uppajjati. Tathā dīgharattaṃ akkhaṇḍatādivasena attanā rakkhitaṃ catupārisuddhisīlaṃ paccavekkhantassa, gihino dasasīlaṃ pañcasīlaṃ paccavekkhantassa, dubbhikkhabhayādīsu paṇītaṃ bhojanaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ datvā ‘‘evaṃnāma dānaṃ adāsi’’nti attanocāgaṃ paccavekkhantassa, gihinopi tathārūpe kāle sīlavantānaṃ dinnadānaṃ paccavekkhantassa, yehi guṇehi samannāgatā devā devattaṃ gatā, tathārūpānaṃ guṇānaṃ attani atthitaṃ paccavekkhantassa, samathavipassanāhi vikkhambhitakilese saṭṭhipi sattatipi vassāni asamudācarante disvā ‘‘aho mayhaṃ kilesā na samudācarantī’’ti cintentassa, cetiyadassanatheradassanesu asakkaccakiriyāya saṃsucitalūkhabhāvena buddhādīsu pasādasinehābhāvena gadrabhapiṭṭhe rajasadise lūkhapuggale parivajjantassa, buddhādīsu pasādabahule muducitte siniddhapuggale paṭisevantassa, ratanattayaguṇaparidīpake pasādanīyasuttante paccavekkhantassa, ṭhānanisajjādīsupi pītiuppādanatthaṃ tanninnatādivasena pavattentassa yebhuyyena pīti uppajjati. Pītiyā ca somanassena saha avinābhāvato taduppattiyā tassāpi uppatti niyatāti evaṃ pītikāraṇānipi somanassakāraṇānīti daṭṭhabbāni. Kiñca – agambhīrapakatitā, somanassapaṭisandhikatāti imehi dvīhi kāraṇehi somanassasahagatatā hoti. Yo hi agambhīrapakatiko hoti, appamattakepi hitopakaraṇe tussati, yo ca somanassapaṭisandhiko appasannesu ārammaṇesupi appaṭikkūladassāvī, tassa yebhuyyena somanassasahagatacittaṃ uppajjati. Yathāvuttānaṃ pana somanassakāraṇānamabhāvena majjhattārammaṇatāya ca upekkhāsahagatatā veditabbā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 再者，有十一种法有助于喜觉支的生起。即：念佛、念法、念僧、念戒、念施、念天、念寂静、远离粗恶之人、亲近柔善之人、省思令人净信的经典、倾向于此。由此等因缘，当知心与乐俱行。忆念佛陀等功德时，乃至近行定生起时，遍满全身的喜便会生起。同样，长久以来以无缺等方式守护自己的四遍清净戒，当省思时；在家者当省思十戒、五戒时；在饥荒、恐惧等情况下，将上妙食物布施给同梵行者之后，当省思‘我曾如此布施’时；在家者亦于此时省思布施给持戒者之物时；省思天人以何等功德证得天界，自己亦具备彼等功德时；看到烦恼以止观镇伏六十、七十年而不现行，当思惟‘啊！我的烦恼没有现行’时；远离那些粗恶之人，他们因在见佛塔、长老时不恭敬的行为，以及对佛陀等缺乏净信与爱意，而显现出粗恶相，如同驴背上的灰尘般；亲近那些对佛陀等具足净信、内心柔软的柔善之人；省思阐明三宝功德的令人净信的经典；为了产生喜，在行住坐卧等姿态中亦倾向于此，大多时候会生起喜。由于喜与乐不可分离，喜生起时，乐也必定生起。因此，应当知道喜的因也是乐的因。此外，由于性格不深沉、以及是乐结生者，这两个原因，心与乐俱行。那些性格不深沉的人，对于微小的利益也会感到满足；那些乐结生者，即使面对不令人愉快的所缘，也不会觉得厌恶，他们大多会生起与乐俱行的心。如果上述乐的因不存在，并且由于所缘为中性，应当知道心与舍相应。
entries.english: Moreover, there are these eleven things that lead to the arising of the rapture factor of enlightenment. Namely: recollection of the Buddha, recollection of the Dhamma, recollection of the Sangha, recollection of virtue, recollection of generosity, recollection of deities, recollection of peace; avoiding coarse persons, associating with amiable persons; reflecting on inspiring discourses, and being inclined toward that. On account of these causes, too, being accompanied by joy should be understood. For one who recollects the qualities of the Buddha and so on, rapture arises, suffusing the entire body up to the arising of access concentration. Likewise, rapture generally arises for one reflecting on the fourfold purity of virtue one has long protected; for a householder reflecting on the ten or five precepts; for one reflecting on one's own generosity after giving to spiritual companions in a time of need; for a householder reflecting on gifts given to the virtuous; for one reflecting on the presence in oneself of the qualities by which deities attained their state; for one reflecting on how one's defilements, suppressed by serenity and insight, have not been active for sixty or seventy years; for one who avoids coarse persons and associates with amiable persons; for one who reflects on inspiring discourses that illuminate the qualities of the Three Jewels; and for one who is inclined toward that, acting with the aim of arousing rapture. Since rapture is inseparable from joy, with the arising of the former, the arising of the latter is certain. Thus, the causes of rapture should also be seen as causes of joy. Furthermore, being accompanied by joy occurs for two other reasons: having a shallow nature and having a joyful rebirth-linking. For one who has a shallow nature is pleased even by a slight favor, and one with a joyful rebirth-linking sees even unpleasing objects as not repulsive; for such a person, consciousness accompanied by joy usually arises. However, through the absence of the aforesaid causes of joy and because the object is neutral, being accompanied by equanimity should be understood.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门古复注 Abhidhammāvatāra-Purāṇaṭīkā
entries.pali: ‘‘Iṭṭhārammaṇatā saddhābāhulyaṃ diṭṭhisuddhi ca; Phaladassāvitā ceva, pītibojjhaṅgahetuyo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 可喜所缘，信根增盛，见地清净，以及示现果报，是喜觉支的因缘。
entries.english: “Desirability of the object, abundance of faith, and purity of view, and also seeing the fruit: these are the causes of the enlightenment factor of rapture.
